title: The Greatest Goan Stories Ever Told

vibeProfile.oneLine: An anthology of the greatest short stories from Goa.

summary: An anthology gathering the finest short stories from Goa, the small former Portuguese colony on India's west coast with a literary culture all its own. Bringing together writers across languages and generations, the collection captures Goa beyond the beaches: its Catholic and Hindu worlds, its migrations, its music and food, its layered colonial past and its distinctive sensibility. A rich, varied introduction to the storytelling of a place unlike anywhere else in India.
whyReadIt: The finest Goan short stories in one anthology, Goa beyond the beaches. Rich, varied and full of a singular place.

funFacts.text: Goa has a distinctive literary tradition shaped by Konkani, Marathi, Portuguese and English.
